conversation.session.navigating: A rollback or branch switch is in progress. Try again when it's done.
conversation.session.rollbackNotStopped: {who} didn't stop this turn, so the rollback didn't happen (try again in a moment)
conversation.session.switchNotStopped: {who} didn't stop this turn, so the branch switch didn't happen (try again in a moment)
conversation.session.notReady: {who} didn't start, so the rollback didn't happen
conversation.session.noModelKey: No model set up yet: there's no {provider} API key. See Settings · Models for how to add one, then restart ergo
conversation.session.summaryTimeout: Writing the branch summary timed out
conversation.compaction.detail: {why}: recent messages are kept as they are; earlier ones were condensed into a summary (the full history is still viewable)
conversation.compaction.detailWithTokens: {why}: the context was about {tokens} tokens before compacting; recent messages are kept as they are, earlier ones were condensed into a summary (the full history is still viewable)
conversation.compaction.threshold: The context was nearly at the model's limit, so it was compacted automatically
conversation.compaction.overflow: The context exceeded the model's limit, so it was compacted automatically and continued
conversation.compaction.timeout: The model call for compaction timed out, so the agent process was stopped (the session is unchanged and restarts from where it was)
conversation.compaction.childExited: The agent process exited while compacting
conversation.messages.keyReused: This idempotency key was already used for another request
conversation.messages.cannotSendTo: This version can't send messages to {conversation} yet
conversation.messages.notImage: "{name}" isn't an image (only JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP are supported). Send it as a file instead.
conversation.messages.noVoice: This version can't send voice messages yet
conversation.messages.voiceAlone: A voice message can contain only one recording (cards and attachments are fine), not text or other recordings
conversation.messages.browsingSecretaryO: Web page context can only be attached in the secretary's chat
conversation.messages.noAttachment: Attachment "{name}" not found: media {mediaId} isn't stored (upload and finish it before sending)
conversation.queue.keyReused: Couldn't queue the message: idempotency key {key} was already used for another request
conversation.modelSwitch.done: Switched to {model} and continuing the conversation.
conversation.modelSwitch.failed: Couldn't switch to {to}: writing the handoff summary failed ({error}). This turn still uses {from}; it'll try again next turn.
conversation.scopeReview.exited: {who}'s process exited during the scope review ({reason})
conversation.scopeReview.timeout: The scope review took more than {seconds} s without a result
conversation.rollback.onlyThisSegment: You can only roll back within this part of the conversation (since the last clear or model switch; for a project maintainer, the current segment; for scheduled or event-triggered runs, this run)
conversation.rollback.noMessage: This message isn't in this conversation
conversation.rollback.onlyYours: You can only roll back to before a message you sent
conversation.rollback.prelude: This is part of the history brought in at takeover, so you can't roll back to before it
conversation.rollback.messageOffPath: This message isn't on the current branch
conversation.rollback.batch: This message was handed over together with the ones before it. Roll back to before the first one in that batch.
conversation.rollback.pending: This message hasn't been handed over yet. Just remove it.
conversation.rollback.branchOffPath: This branch isn't on the current path
conversation.rollback.noStageMark: This conversation has no rollback point for the start of this stage
conversation.rollback.stageOffPath: The start of this stage isn't on the current branch
conversation.rollback.stepOffPath: The start of this step isn't on the current branch
conversation.rollback.briefOffPath: This stage's brief isn't on the current branch
conversation.rollback.briefPending: This stage's brief hasn't reached the maintainer yet, so you can't roll back to before it started
conversation.rollback.stageBusy: The maintainer was busy with something else when stage "{title}" started, so you can't roll back to exactly that point. Roll back to an earlier request instead.
conversation.rollback.stageRolledBack: What happened after stage "{title}" started has already been rolled back. Roll back from the branch summary instead.
conversation.rollback.whyDeleted: Deleted or overwritten, with no backup
conversation.rollback.noSummary: (No branch summary was written for this part)
conversation.rollback.noTip: This branch has no recorded end, so you can't switch to it
conversation.rollback.switchThisSegment: You can only switch to branches created since the last clear or model switch
conversation.rollback.switchCleared: That branch was cleared or switched models, so you can't switch to it
conversation.rollback.busy: A rollback is in progress. Try again when it's done.
conversation.rollback.currentBranch: This is the current branch. Undo requests are made from an abandoned branch's details.
conversation.rollback.noEffect: This branch has no such action
conversation.runtimeQuestion.turnEnded: This round has ended; no answer is needed
conversation.runtimeQuestion.wrongAction: This card doesn't take that action
conversation.runtimeQuestion.problem.unk: Question {n}: that choice isn't on the card
conversation.runtimeQuestion.inbox.plan: {runtime}'s plan is waiting for your approval
conversation.runtimeQuestion.text.plan: {source}: {runtime} has a plan waiting for your approval
conversation.runtimeSwitch.done: Switched to {to}, continuing the conversation (with a handoff summary).
conversation.runtimeSwitch.fresh: Switched to {to}; a new session starts here.
conversation.runtimeSwitch.noSummary: Switched to {to}; a new session starts here. {from} couldn't write a handoff summary: {error}
conversation.runtimeSwitch.timeout: The handoff summary took longer than {seconds} seconds
